summary: Foresight Autonomous Holdings Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on June 18, 2026, announcing its Annual and Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders to be held on July 23, 2026. The filing includes the voting instruction form for holders of American Depositary Shares. Record date is July 6, 2026. The meeting covers routine corporate governance matters. This is a standard procedural filing with no special-situation catalyst such as acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, or strategic reviews. No deal terms, premiums, or structural changes are present. The 6-K is incorporated by reference into several registration statements. This is an ordinary current report, not a special situation.
